title: How E.ON uses SAP S/4HANA to modernise the grid with AI
summary: E.ON, a major utility company, is leveraging SAP S/4HANA to standardize grid data and modernize their energy infrastructure across three business domains: energy grids, customer solutions, and energy infrastructure solutions. This standardization enables them to execute AI deployments while managing continuous capital expenditure requirements for IT hardware and software maintenance.
problem_solved: E.ON needed to unify data across diverse energy infrastructure operations to enable AI deployments while justifying the business case for large-scale digital transformation to leadership.
why_valuable: This case demonstrates how enterprise ERP standardization can serve as a foundation for AI adoption in critical infrastructure sectors like energy utilities, enabling scalability and operational efficiency.
